caption: Same two processes and bursts, scheduled both ways. Without preemption P1 runs 0–8 ms and P2 waits until 8 ms; with preemption P2 runs 1–5 ms and P1 resumes at 5 ms, cutting P2's wait from 7 ms to 0.

spec.aria: Two timelines for the same two processes: without preemption P1 runs 0 to 8 ms then P2 runs 8 to 12 ms; with preemption P2 runs 1 to 5 ms and P1 resumes 5 to 12 ms.
